semantic_boundary: Provider execution is not review outcome; review outcome is not independently verified code defect; provider quota is not a code review finding.
evidence_rules: Classify provider failure cause only from recognized machine error codes or timestamp-related provider-origin notice text with an evidence id.
Only individually addressable reported findings count; a generic failed review, has_any_findings flag, or incidental discussion quote is not a confirmed finding.
An aborted review without explicit findings is NOT_ASSESSED, never NO_FINDINGS or CODE_DEFECTS.
An exhausted CI runner with zero steps is NOT_STARTED, never a tested-code failure.
Stale reviewed commits cannot establish current candidate outcome.
Provider raw status, execution proof, substantive findings, capability availability and merge authority are separate.
No retry, approval, authorization, merge, credential exchange, provider write or private text disclosure is performed.
